note: The hero list hero-ban answers read (migration 049), loaded by `python -m owcsmuse heroes load` and on every `migrate`. `name` is the canonical spelling: Liquipedia's, the only source of bans (owner, 2026-11-03). `aliases` are other spellings that mean the same hero: FACEIT's (DVa, LifeWeaver, Lucio, Torbjorn, Soldier 76) and what people type. `available_from` is the first day (UTC) the hero could be banned in OWCS play; null means it was available before hero bans began. A hero is counted as available on a map played on or after that day, which is what makes 'never banned' correct: a hero not yet in the game cannot be one. `basis` says where the date came from: 'pool_at_bans_start' heroes were in the pool when bans began; 'owner' dates are the first stored evidence of the hero in the OWCS pool, accepted by the owner on 2026-11-03 as the conservative choice (`window` is the bracket the stored data allows: the last stored room whose pool lacked the hero, and the first evidence of it). A later date than the true one only leaves the hero out of 'never banned' for maps it could have been banned on; it never makes a false claim.
bans_introduced_note: Owner, 2026-11-03: hero bans were introduced in 2025, so a 2024 map has none. The first ban in the warehouse is 2025-01-31.
